info.title: Company Website to LinkedIn & Social Media Links
info.description:
Which social profiles belong to this company? Resolves a name, website or Google Maps listing to its LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook handles, with evidence. Instagram and Facebook are returned from the site on the default path, not platform-verified.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder
Author: Public Records.

tags.name: runs
tags.description: Start a run and read dataset items

post.description: Starts the Actor asynchronously. Poll the returned run, then read dataset items. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder

      "title": "Identifiers to resolve",
      "type": "array",
      "description": "One per line. A website domain (acme.com), any organization or profile URL (https://www.instagram.com/acme, https://www.linkedin.com/company/acme), a prefixed handle (ig:acme, x:acme, tiktok:acme, yt:@acme, fb:acme, gh:acme), a Google Maps place ID (ChIJ…), an SEC CIK/ticker (cik:320193, ticker:NET), an LEI — or a company name, optionally with a location (\"Acme Plumbing, Toronto\"). Names resolve only when exactly one candidate is unambiguous; otherwise you get a ranked `candidates` row (free) to pick from. Organizations and places only — people are refused.",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "prefill": [
        "apify.com",
        "https://www.instagram.com/apifytech"
      ],
      "minItems": 0,
      "maxItems": 5000
    },
    "query": {
      "title": "Single identifier",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "One identifier or company name (for agents, Zapier/Make steps, quick checks). Output defaults to compact for a single query.",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "nullable": true
    },
    "inputDatasetId": {
      "title": "Enrich a dataset (on-ramp)",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "ID of any dataset — a Google Maps, LinkedIn jobs or company-scraper run, or an uploaded CSV. Each row's website field is resolved and the result is attached to the row as `crosswalk`; all original fields pass through. Leave `queries` empty when using this.",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "nullable": true
    },
    "domainField": {
      "title": "Website field in that dataset",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Auto-detected (website, websiteUrl, companyUrl, url, domain, homepage…) when empty.",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "nullable": true
    },
    "maxRows": {
      "title": "Max rows to enrich",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 5000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 100000,
      "description": "Maximum number of dataset rows to enrich in one run when inputDatasetId is set.",
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "outputFormat": {
      "title": "Output format",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "auto (default): compact for a single `query`, full for batches and datasets. compact: flat record with ids, urls, confidence and a verified flag — best for tool calls and spreadsheets. full: complete record with the evidence trail per link.",
      "enum": [
        "auto",
        "compact",
        "full"
      ],
      "enumTitles": [
        "Auto (compact for one query, full for batches)",
        "Compact",
        "Full (with evidence)"
      ],
      "default": "auto",
      "editor": "select"
    },
    "mode": {
      "title": "Mode",
      "sectionCaption": "Advanced",
      "sectionDescription": "Verification depth, cache, politeness and other run settings. Defaults are the listed default path.",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "resolve: resolve the queries (default). healthcheck: run the canary set and FAIL the run on degradation (schedule hourly; wire an alert to run failure). reverify: re-resolve slice k of n of the graph with change events (schedule daily). export: dump the whole graph to the dataset (no charges). forget: purge the organizations in forgetIds. buildSecIndex: build the SEC ticker/CIK ↔ domain index used to enrich public companies (run monthly). seed: pre-resolve organizations (list / SEC / Wikidata) so first-touch lookups are served from the graph (still billed as entity-resolved). healthcheck / reverify / seed / buildSecIndex: publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs. export / forget: normal buyer/ops.",
      "enum": [
        "resolve",
        "healthcheck",
        "reverify",
        "export",
        "forget",
        "buildSecIndex",
        "seed"
      ],
      "enumTitles": [
        "Resolve queries / enrich dataset",
        "Healthcheck (canaries); publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs",
        "Re-verify graph slice; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs",
        "Export graph",
        "Forget / purge",
        "Build SEC index; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs",
        "Seed the graph; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs"
      ],
      "default": "resolve",
      "editor": "select"
    },
    "probeMode": {
      "title": "Verification depth",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "direct (default): free public endpoints only; Instagram/Facebook links are reported as not_attempted unless enableChildProbes is true. The listed Store price covers this path and excludes optional child probes. auto / actors (experimental, untested by us): Instagram and Facebook confirmation starts official Store child Actors only when enableChildProbes is true; the buyer pays those Store Actor charges (we do not absorb them). Historical lift of probe vs direct is ≈ 0%. actors: confirm every platform through Store Actors (buyer-paid child charges; Instagram/Facebook still require enableChildProbes). declared: read the organization's website only.",
      "enum": [
        "auto",
        "direct",
        "actors",
        "declared"
      ],
      "enumTitles": [
        "Auto — experimental Store Actor probes (buyer pays child IG/FB charges)",
        "Direct — free endpoints only (default)",
        "Actors — experimental; Store Actors for every platform (buyer pays)",
        "Declared — website only"
      ],
      "default": "direct",
      "editor": "select"
    },
    "enableChildProbes": {
      "title": "Enable Instagram/Facebook child probes",
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "When true, Instagram/Facebook Store Actors run on the user's account at those Actors' own rates; default off so listed Crosswalk price is the true price without child spend.",
      "default": false,
      "prefill": false,
      "editor": "checkbox"
    },
    "maxChildRuns": {
      "title": "Max child runs",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 2,
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 2,
      "description": "Max Instagram/Facebook child runs that reached RUNNING in this parent run (one batched Instagram call plus one batched Facebook call). A start failure does not count. Default 2.",
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "maxChildCostUsd": {
      "title": "Max child cost (USD)",
      "type": "number",
      "default": 1,
      "minimum": 0,
      "description": "Stop starting further Instagram/Facebook children when read-back charged USD reaches this amount. Default 1.00. Each child Actor.call also sets maxTotalChargeUsd to min(0.25, remaining budget).",
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "actorProbesPerEntity": {
      "title": "Actor probes per organization",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 2,
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 10,
      "description": "Cap on Store-Actor confirmations per organization. Instagram and Facebook count only when enableChildProbes is true (direct, auto, or actors). Instagram + Facebook = 2.",
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "actorProbesPerRun": {
      "title": "Actor probes per run",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 200,
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 100000,
      "description": "Hard cap on Store-Actor confirmations for the whole run; beyond it, links are reported as not_attempted. Keeps sub-run spend predictable.",
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "maxProbesPerEntity": {
      "title": "Max platform probes per entity",
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Upper bound on reverse-confirmation requests made for one organization. Keeps cost predictable in actors mode.",
      "default": 8,
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 40,
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "cacheTtlDays": {
      "title": "Cache freshness (days)",
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "A cached record younger than this is returned without re-resolving and billed as entity-resolved. Set 0 to always re-resolve.",
      "default": 30,
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 365,
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "forceRefresh": {
      "title": "Force refresh",
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Ignore the cache and re-resolve every query. Identity-change events are still computed against the cached record.",
      "default": false,
      "editor": "checkbox"
    },
    "emitChangeEvents": {
      "title": "Emit identity-change events",
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "When a re-resolved organization differs from its cached record (new domain, moved handle, closed place, rebrand), push an identity_change row.",
      "default": true,
      "editor": "checkbox"
    },
    "graphStoreName": {
      "title": "Graph store name",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Named key-value store in your account that holds the identity graph. Leave empty to use crosswalk-graph-<this Actor's ID>, so every run of this Actor compounds the same graph.",
      "editor": "textfield"
    },
    "sharedGraphStoreId": {
      "title": "Shared graph store (advanced)",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "ID of the publisher's public, pre-seeded graph store. Reads fall through to it, so well-known companies resolve from the shared graph (billed as entity-resolved). Defaults to the store the publisher configured; leave empty unless you run your own fork.",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "nullable": true
    },
    "confidentThreshold": {
      "title": "Confident-link threshold",
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Links at or above this confidence count as confident. Links below are still returned, flagged low confidence, and never charged.",
      "default": 0.8,
      "minimum": 0.5,
      "maximum": 1,
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "probeActors": {
      "title": "Actor probes (advanced)",
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Only used when a Store Actor confirms a platform (auto/actors, or Instagram/Facebook when enableChildProbes is true). Maps a platform key to the Actor and how to read its output. Defaults (apify/instagram-profile-scraper, apify/facebook-pages-scraper, harvestapi/linkedin-company, clockworks/tiktok-profile-scraper, apidojo/twitter-user-scraper, compass/crawler-google-places) live in src/platforms.js; override here without a code change. Shape: { \"instagram\": { \"actorId\": \"...\", \"input\": { \"usernames\": [\"{{id}}\"] }, \"externalUrlField\": [\"externalUrl\",\"externalUrls\"], \"nameField\": \"fullName\", \"bioField\": \"biography\" } }",
      "editor": "json",
      "default": {}
    },
    "proxyConfiguration": {
      "title": "Proxy",
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Proxy for website and direct-probe requests. Residential is rarely needed; the hub method reads the organization's own site.",
      "editor": "proxy",
      "default": {
        "useApifyProxy": true
      }
    },
    "requestTimeoutSecs": {
      "title": "Request timeout (seconds)",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 20,
      "minimum": 5,
      "maximum": 120,
      "description": "HTTP request timeout in seconds for website and platform fetches.",
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "maxConcurrency": {
      "title": "Max concurrent resolutions",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 5,
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 25,
      "description": "Maximum number of organizations resolved in parallel.",
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "renderFallbackActor": {
      "title": "Render fallback Actor (advanced)",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "For JavaScript-only websites. A Store Actor that returns rendered HTML in an `html` field for a `url` input (e.g. apify/web-fetch). Sub-runs bill to you. Leave empty to diagnose JS-only sites instead.",
      "editor": "textfield",
      "nullable": true
    },
    "seedTimeoutSecs": {
      "title": "Per-query timeout (seconds)",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 120,
      "minimum": 20,
      "maximum": 900,
      "description": "One slow organization never stalls the run; abandoned queries get a `seed_timeout` diagnostic and are not charged.",
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "perHostPerSecond": {
      "title": "Politeness: requests per second per host",
      "type": "number",
      "default": 2,
      "minimum": 0.2,
      "maximum": 10,
      "description": "Maximum requests per second to any single host (politeness limiter).",
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "respectRobots": {
      "title": "Respect robots.txt on organization websites",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true,
      "description": "When a site's robots.txt disallows reading, Crosswalk reports `website_robots_denied` instead of reading it.",
      "editor": "checkbox"
    },
    "forgetIds": {
      "title": "Forget: identifiers or canonicalIds to purge",
      "type": "array",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "description": "forget mode only. Domains, platform URLs or org_… ids. Removes the record, its history and all indexes.",
      "default": []
    },
    "probeConcurrency": {
      "title": "Parallel probes per organization",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 4,
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 8,
      "description": "How many platform probes to run in parallel for one organization.",
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "wikidataDeclared": {
      "title": "Use Wikidata as a second declared source",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true,
      "description": "Wikidata's human-curated social properties for the organization whose official website is this domain are added as declared links (0.85) and still platform-verified. Independent of the website, so JS-only footers and robots-denied sites still resolve.",
      "editor": "checkbox"
    },
    "reverifySlice": {
      "title": "Maintenance: Re-verify: slice index",
      "sectionCaption": "Publisher maintenance (not for buyer runs)",
      "sectionDescription": "Used only by the publisher’s reverify and seed schedules. Buyer runs ignore these fields.",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 0,
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 999,
      "description": "reverify mode only. Which slice (0..slices-1) to re-resolve today. Schedule with a rotating value or use a daily task per slice.; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs",
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "reverifySlices": {
      "title": "Maintenance: Re-verify: number of slices",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 30,
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 1000,
      "description": "How many deterministic slices to partition the graph into for reverify mode.; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs",
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "reverifyLimit": {
      "title": "Maintenance: Re-verify: max organizations per run",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 500,
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 20000,
      "description": "Maximum number of organizations to re-verify in one run.; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs",
      "editor": "number"
    },
    "seedSource": {
      "title": "Maintenance: Seed: source",
      "type": "string",
      "description": "seed mode only. list = seedDomains; sec = domains from the SEC index; wikidata = organizations with an official website (paged, resumable).; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs",
      "enum": [
        "list",
        "sec",
        "wikidata"
      ],
      "default": "list",
      "editor": "select"
    },
    "seedDomains": {
      "title": "Maintenance: Seed: domains (list source)",
      "type": "array",
      "editor": "stringList",
      "default": [],
      "description": "Explicit list of domains to seed when seedSource is list.; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs"
    },
    "seedLimit": {
      "title": "Maintenance: Seed: organizations per run",
      "type": "integer",
      "default": 2000,
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 50000,
      "description": "Maximum number of organizations to seed in one run.; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs",
      "editor": "number"
    }
  },
  "required": []
}
